_note: Openly licensed photographs AfriEdge may show, all from Wikimedia Commons. pipelines.images checks each file's licence with the Commons API at download time (only CC0, public domain, CC BY and CC BY-SA are accepted; GFDL is not, because it requires reproducing the full licence text), stores a copy under apps/web/public/media/library/ and records author, licence and fingerprint in config/image_library.lock.json. Every use shows the caption and credit. These photos show the institution or the city, never a news event: on news stories they are labelled as the publisher's building or the city, so a reader cannot take them for a picture of what happened. Excluded: File:CRDB BANK.png (2026-10-09) is CRDB's trademarked logo marked CC0 by an uploader who is not shown to own it; it is not a photograph.
